UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences, companion customization and personality preset settings

relationship.description: Relationship persona: partner, friend, mentor, rebel, zen, coach

customInstructions.description: Custom prompt directives or personality tuning

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single chat message exchange in the conversation history

role.description: Role of speaker: user, model, or error

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent

MemoryItem.title: MemoryItem
MemoryItem.description: A remembered fact or user detail preserved in the long-term memory brain

fact.description: The specific fact or preference learned about the user

category.description: Memory category tag (General, Preference, Goal, Personal, Work)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the memory was stored

/users/{userId}.description: Stores companion profile, personality preset and settings for the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of chat history messages belonging to the user

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Collection of lasting memories and facts stored in the memory brain
